story_type: basket hoist from a small Coast Guard boat to a Jayhawk far offshore, filmed looking up from the boat
hook: 46 miles out, a basket rose from a small boat to a Jayhawk.
narration: Forty-six miles off North Carolina, a basket rose off a small boat toward a hovering Jayhawk.
Inside was a cadet from a Uruguayan Navy training ship, with abdominal pain.
A boat crew from Station Wrightsville Beach handled the transfer to the helicopter.
From a moving boat, the boat holds a steady course and the pilot matches it from above.
[short pause] The basket climbed through the rotor wash and reached the door.
outcome: The Elizabeth City crew hoisted the patient aboard, forty-six miles out.
title: 46 miles out, hoisted off a small boat
description:
On Aug. 7, 2019, a Coast Guard Station Wrightsville Beach boat crew transferred a patient to an MH-60 Jayhawk from Air Station Elizabeth City 46 miles off North Carolina. One of the two passengers transferred was a cadet from a Uruguayan naval training vessel with abdominal pain.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Petty Officer 1st Class Mark Ward, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/701665/coast-guard-medevacs-uruguayan-naval-cadet-46-miles-off-north-carolina
